title: Uniform register bound
statement: For a natural number $B$ and a machine state with counters and registers $n,a,X,P,T,Z,C,s,w,K,U,V,M,I,SE,SP,E,Q$, the state is bounded by $B$ exactly when each of these eighteen quantities is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: All eighteen state quantities are at most B
